transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this re-entry meeting. As you know, one of our ninth-grade students is returning after missing four days due to a concussion, and I need to approve the re-entry plan for the next two school weeks. I've reviewed the draft plan, which currently keeps the student on the full daily schedule, permits ordinary PE participation, allows up to three make-up assignments per day, and schedules an in-person counselor check-in after school. Before I approve anything, I want to hear from each of you. Nurse, teachers, counselor — please share any information you have that should cause us to change this draft plan. I want to make sure we're doing right by this student.

transcript.text: I need to share important information from the physician's return-to-school note that I reviewed this morning. The note was faxed to the nurse's office but has not yet been entered in the student-information system. The physician explicitly prohibits physical education and contact sports for exactly 10 school days, and requires a 20-minute rest break after lunch during that period. This directly conflicts with the draft plan's allowance of ordinary PE participation, and the plan does not include the required rest break.
